QuestInfo.name: Magnus's Plan
QuestInfo.0: You obtained some information on Magnus from the priests at the Heretic Temple, but you could use some more. Angelic Detective... ACTIVATE!
QuestInfo.1: Go back into the depths of the Heretic Temple and see if you can get some more information on Magnus. Return to #p3000000# in #m400000000# when you have it.
QuestInfo.2: Magnus's army is in worse shape than they'd like to think, and he seems afraid to admit it to Darmoor. #p3000000# was thrilled to hear the news.

0.0: I should do one more good deed before I go dimension-hopping. I bet I can find out some super awesome stuff if I go back to that Heretic Base! Maybe I'll find some pretty pebbles there too! Or a super cute dog! Angelic Possibilities!

yes.0: If I search every nook, cranny, and nanny, I'm gonna find SOMETHING. I can feel it in my wings! Maybe I'll just take it back over to Mr. #p3000000# when I'm done.

no.0: And Magnus is all busted up! I don't need to worry about that chump.

1.0: Oh, Angelic Buster! You, uh, how about that dinner? \r\n#L0# #b(You tell him what you found out about Magnus and the heretics.)#l\n#k
1.1: Magnus was behind it the whole time? That makes sense... but I fear what will happen to us if Magnus sets his pride aside long enough to get Darmoor's complete support.

yes.0: If we're lucky, Magnus will remain his stubborn self long enough for us to get our forces together. Thank you for providing us with your information...

default.0: #p3000000# in #m400000000# is really going to want a report.
